periods.time: Delayed final day and aftermath of the 62nd Seven Stars Sword-Art Festival
periods.label: 第六十二届七星剑王
periods.species: human Blazer; newly awakened fate-transcending existence / Desperado-class potential

status.current: defeats Stella in the Seven Stars final and receives the championship title
status.condition: survives cardiac arrest, exhausts Ittou Shura, then breaks through his fixed magic limit by force of will and love

relationships.stella-vermillion: Fiancee, lover and strongest rival; he refuses to let anyone else become her strongest and consummates their relationship after the final.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Younger sister; she worries through the final and later rages after discovering his night with Stella.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Friend who helps tune him before the final and guards him afterward.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Former opponent who pushes him to enter the final with absolute confidence.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Elder brother who tests whether his weak sword can face a dragon.

periods.summary: Ikki wakes from near death just in time for the delayed championship. Afraid of Stella's awakened dragon power, he requests a gauntlet of strong sparring partners and converts fear into peak readiness. In the final he first suppresses Stella with prediction, Madoka and close-range pressure, but Dragon Spirit and the lava field force him into a soul clash. He exhausts Ittou Shura and seems to lose to Stella's finishing blow, yet rejects a respectable defeat inside a vision of fate's chains. His love for Stella and desire to remain her strongest break those chains, raising his magic beyond its fixed limit. He returns at nine, uses Ittou Rasetsu and the final secret sword Oikage to defeat Stella, becomes Seven Stars Sword King, and later stands beside her on the podium after their relationship deepens in the infirmary.

key_events.summary: Uses allies and rivals to sharpen his body and confidence before facing Stella.
Breaks fate's chains, awakens new magic, creates Oikage, and wins the final.
Confesses his possessive love for Stella and becomes her lover physically.
Receives the Seven Stars Sword King title and raises Hagun's flag.

periods.time: Immediately after winning the 62nd Seven Stars Sword-Art Festival and during his first visit to Vermillion
periods.label: 七星剑王赴法米利昂求婚试炼
titles: 第62届七星剑武祭优胜者
法米利昂战争临时代表
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; Vermillion royal household candidate by engagement trial

status.current: accepted by Vermillion citizens in principle and tasked to help win the war against Quedolan
status.condition: injured by Daniel Dandalion but remains determined

relationships.stella-vermillion: Lover and intended fiancee; he reassures her that he loves Vermillion because its people love and protect her.
relationships.sirius-vermillion: Prospective father-in-law who secretly orchestrates a national manhunt against him before reluctantly agreeing to a trial.
relationships.lunaeyes-vermillion: Prospective sister-in-law who sets the condition that Ikki help Vermillion win the war.
relationships.daniel-dandalion: Elite sword instructor who tests him at the castle wall and entrusts Stella to him after defeat.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Explains Ikki's Desperado awakening and asks him to protect Japan's future.

periods.summary: Ikki celebrates his Seven Stars victory in Osaka, then meets Tsukikage at the Bay Dome and learns that using a second Ittou Shura against Stella was a Desperado awakening. He accepts the need to keep the truth secret while rejecting Tsukikage's help until Tsukikage explains the future war he foresaw. During his trip to Vermillion, Ikki is attacked by citizens, soldiers, young C-rank knights, royal guards, and Daniel Dandalion because the nation wants to test the man who would take Stella. Instead of resenting them, he concludes that their hostility comes from love for Stella. He publicly asks Stella's family to test him and pledges to meet any demand, then accepts Lunaeyes's condition that he fight for Vermillion in the war against Quedolan.

key_events.summary: Fights Ascaride with Stella and learns he has entered the Desperado realm.
Hears Tsukikage's explanation of his anti-League plot and the future destruction of Tokyo.
Is hunted across Freyja Vorg by citizens and the army as a national test.
Breaks through the royal guard, defeats Dandalion, and reaches the castle.
Publicly pledges himself to Stella and accepts the war victory condition.

periods.time: Before and during the opening of the Vermillion-Quedland crisis
periods.label: 法米利昂代表与卡尔迪亚战场之眼
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; Vermillion side by trial and promise

status.current: survives Or-Gaule's ambush and the Caldia battle opening; continues supporting Vermillion despite depleted magic
status.condition: healed by Alice Ascaride's Unbreakable after severe wounds; later badly injured after luring B.B. away from troops

relationships.stella-vermillion: Lover and fiancee candidate; fights to be accepted by her family and to protect her homeland.
relationships.sirius-vermillion: Future father-in-law who tests him repeatedly and finally treats the war as Ikki's proof of family membership.
relationships.astrea-vermillion: Future mother-in-law who supports him and recognizes his sincerity.
relationships.lunaeyes-vermillion: Ally who asks him to train Vermillion fighters and accompany her to Quedland.
relationships.milialia-regi: Sniper partner during the Caldia operation; she marks targets that Ikki identifies.
relationships.alice-ascaride: Saves him from Or-Gaule, heals him with Unbreakable, and later shields him from B.B.

periods.summary: Ikki endures Sirius Vermillion's comic but serious acceptance tests, defeating him instantly in simulated combat, arm wrestling, and a marathon errand. He accepts Lunaeyes' request to train Timid and Milialia, then visits Quedland with Stella and Lunaeyes. During Or-Gaule's ambush, Ikki alone reacts fast enough to intercept Killing Opera with Ittou Rasetsu, saving the crowd at the cost of massive wounds and exhaustion. After Alice Ascaride evacuates and heals him, Ikki proposes the Caldia plan: he will act as Vermillion's aerial eyes, read the puppet-command wave patterns from a helicopter, and have Milialia mark relay nodes. He performs this role successfully until B.B. destroys the helicopter. Despite no magic and broken bones, Ikki blinds B.B. and deliberately lures the giant away from unconscious soldiers, nearly dying before Alice arrives.

key_events.summary: Defeats Sirius in successive tests while showing patience toward Sirius' fatherly jealousy.
Blocks Or-Gaule's mass-murder strike with Ittou Rasetsu and is gravely injured.
Identifies Or-Gaule's relay nodes from the air so Vermillion can free Quedland soldiers without killing them.
Lures B.B. away from the central avenue after the giant destroys the helicopter.

abilities: Ittou Shura physiology and focus control

periods.time: During the Edelberg trip before the representative war
periods.label: 剑峰魔力控制修行与信任史黛菈

status.current: returns to Vermillion after learning higher-efficiency magic control from Edelweiss
status.condition: physically exhausted from high-altitude training but mentally resolved

relationships.stella-vermillion: Lover and rival; he trusts her selfhood despite wanting to rescue her.
relationships.edelweiss: Sword idol and temporary mentor who trains his magic efficiency rather than his sword technique.
relationships.fu-xiaoli: Observed threat whose power worries him during Stella's battle.
relationships.lunaeyes-vermillion: Previously authorized by her as a representative; he fights for Stella's homeland.

periods.summary: Ikki accompanies Stella to Edelberg as both lover and guard, but he accepts her Rule of Graces request to believe in her. Edelweiss hosts him for tea, thanks him for saving Amane Shinomiya, and explains that his swordsmanship is already close enough to hers that further progress must come through magic use. On Edelberg's summit he trains to compress magic into his body and finger while balancing on the mountain's blade-like peak, improving the efficiency of Ittou Shura. When Edelweiss moves to save Stella from Xiaoli, Ikki blocks her, declaring that Stella is fighting for an unyielding self rather than a mere death wish. Using the new magic-defense concept, he briefly repels Edelweiss's blade and buys enough time for Stella to awaken.

key_events.summary: Learns summit training to compress magic and strengthen his techniques.
Stops Edelweiss from rescuing Stella because he chooses to trust Stella's self-belief.

abilities: advanced point magic defense / compressed magic control

periods.time: Night before and opening minutes of the Vermillion-Quedland representative war
periods.label: 以恋人与剑士身份守护法米利昂

status.current: defeats B.B. without injury and turns toward supporting the remaining battlefields
status.condition: calm and physically intact after the opening duel
status.goal: survive the war, protect Stella's homeland, and prove himself to Sirius by his sword

personality.summary: Gentle and self-effacing in private, but fearless and analytical in battle.
values: protecting loved ones without denying their agency
winning through skill rather than status

relationships.stella-vermillion: Lover and comrade; he promises not to die and asks her to trust him as he trusts her.
relationships.sirius-vermillion: Future father-in-law figure who rejects his reasoning yet upholds the sword-trial promise.
relationships.bb: Enemy child; Ikki recognizes B.B.'s will to protect a friend and defeats him while urging him to grow up and think for himself.
relationships.yui-tatara: Teammate whose survival Stella once tied emotionally to Ikki's protection.

periods.summary: During Vermillion's noisy funeral wake, Ikki speaks with Sirius about the country's tradition of smiling for the dead. When Sirius confronts him about stopping Edelweiss from saving Stella, Ikki admits the facts and explains that he could not rob Stella of the struggle she chose as the Crimson Princess. Sirius cannot accept the reasoning as a father, but tells Ikki that the earlier promise remains: if Ikki wants Stella, he must make Sirius acknowledge him with his sword. Later, Stella fears Ikki may die in a real war and asks whether he truly must participate. Ikki answers that Stella's homeland and family are reason enough, embraces her, and vows not to lose or die because her side is where he belongs. At the opening of the representative war, Naseem's sandstorm throws him high into the air. Ikki survives the fall by using his uniform jacket as an improvised parachute and B.B.'s slap-wind to cancel momentum, then faces the giant child. He first tries intimidation and persuasion, but when B.B. declares he fights for Or-Gaule as a friend, Ikki accepts him as a man with conviction. Ikki exploits the gaps and slow tracking caused by B.B.'s enormous size, severs the Achilles and knee tendons, finishes with Rhino Strike to the temple, and comforts the unconscious child before handing him to medics.

key_events.summary: Explains why he let Stella face Fu Xiaoli's crisis and accepts Sirius's sword-based condition.
Promises Stella he will return alive and fight beside her.
Defeats B.B. flawlessly through analysis rather than brute force.
